name: yukineko
description: yukineko's subscription-native Claude Code harness — condukt orchestration, fugu-router model routing, spec/verify gates, and HOTL tooling. No API key; bundled per-platform binaries.

plugins.name: beacon
plugins.description: Desktop & webhook notifications for Claude Code: Stop and Notification hooks that ping you (macOS/Linux desktop, Slack, generic webhook, or a custom command) when a turn finishes or Claude needs your input — so you can step away from long sessions. Subscription-native (two hooks + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: blastguard
plugins.description: Destructive-operation guard for Claude Code: a PreToolUse hook that denies project-wrecking Bash commands and file operations (recursive/wildcard rm, git reset --hard, git clean -fd, single-> truncating overwrites, truncate/shred/mkfs/dd of=, recursive chmod/chown, find -delete, find -ok/-okdir, bare top-level interpreter inline-eval, stacked/versioned interpreter flags, tee truncation) before they run, while exempting repo config files (.claude/**, *.toml, *.yaml/yml, *.lock, package.json, .config/**). Subscription-native (one PreToolUse hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: backlog
plugins.description: Cross-project task queue with cycle-type tags for Claude Code: a /backlog skill that loops through open items (lock → pick → /condukt → done), a SessionStart hook that surfaces pending work at session open, and a backlog binary with list/next/done/fail/lock subcommands. Subscription-native (skill + hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: budgetguard
plugins.description: Real-time cost budget gate for Claude Code: on Stop, read the session transcript, compute USD cost, and block the turn when session or daily limits are exceeded — feeding the overage back so the agent winds down gracefully. Subscription-native (one Stop hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key). v0.1.9: added #![deny(clippy::panic)] at crate root.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: Goal re-grounding + next-move derivation upstream of condukt for Claude Code: when the goal goes fuzzy or you stall after finishing a chunk, it carves the project charter (north star + definition of done + current gap) through an interrogate loop, then routes only the right-sized next move into condukt while parking side-quests to taskprog. Subscription-native (SessionStart nudge + Stop breadcrumb hooks + /compass skill + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: condukt
plugins.description: Deterministic orchestration engine for Claude Code: an interpreter/worker/verifier skill plus a Rust binary that schedules tasks into parallel/serial batches by file-conflict analysis, manages the git-worktree lifecycle, tracks run state, and gates completion. v0.7.60: `verify::run_check` now gates each declared check command through blastguard's pure detector (same `detect("Bash", ...)` call already used by `launch_and_reflux`) before spawning `sh -c`; a flagged command is refused fail-closed and reported as a non-passing `CheckResult` (exit -1) instead of being executed. New test `run_check_blocks_destructive_command_via_blastguard` proves a `rm -rf /` check never reaches the shell. v0.7.59: gatelog.rs's `append_decision`, `append_circuit`, and `append_gate_exec` now use harness-core's `append::append_line()` (single write_all syscall) instead of `writeln!` (body+newline as two syscalls), preventing interleaving of concurrent JSONL records under O_APPEND. Regression test `concurrent_decision_appends_never_interleave` ensures 8 threads appending 100 records each produce parseable lines (all 800 survive, none concatenated). v0.7.58: audited `lessons.rs`'s `harvest()` (production JSON-facts path) — already fail-soft throughout (`.ok()`/`.and_then()`/`.unwrap_or()`), no raw `.unwrap()`/`.expect()`; the flagged calls were inside `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` only. Also fixed a real test flake found while confirming green under parallel execution: a lessons.rs test mutating the process-global `LESSONS_STORE_DIR` env var now serializes via its own `ENV_LOCK` mutex (mirrors the existing `replan.rs` precedent). v0.7.57: `worktree.rs`'s git subprocess calls are now bounded by a 45s timeout (wait_timeout + process-group kill) instead of a plain unbounded `Command::output()`, so a hung `git` can no longer wedge a condukt run indefinitely; `create()`'s "worktree must be outside the repo" check now canonicalizes the candidate worktree path before comparing against the canonical repo root, closing a TOCTOU-adjacent bypass via a non-canonical `worktree_base`. v0.7.56: `verify::tests::skip_eligible_without_command_fails_soft` no longer relies on a `panic!` inside the invariant-violating runner closure — it records the invocation via a flag, logs it, and asserts the flag stays false, so the test path never aborts the process (production `mechanical_skip_verdict` behavior unchanged). v0.7.55: docs-only — SKILL.md Phase 7 documents the `state reconcile` exit 2 (duplicate_completion) escalation branch. v0.7.54: `gate_exec`'s escalate-finding call site follows overwatch's extended `record_finding`/`ReviewFinding.rationale` signature (no behavior change). Subscription-native (skill + agents + hook, no API key).

plugins.name: context-governor
plugins.description: A thin control layer around Claude Code's built-in compaction: pin + lossless-recall + retrieval + tool-hygiene, wired as a single hook-dispatch binary. Separates the three axes it touches — size (window occupancy), cost (recompute/cache), correctness (norm preservation) — and never writes its own lossy summarizer (compression is delegated to built-in compaction). Subscription-native (hooks + binary, no API key).

plugins.name: ctxrot
plugins.description: Context-rot guard for Claude Code: detect, rescue, restore, distill, and CONTROL what loads into context (rule-based allow/deny gate + /ctx pin/drop/load + switchable carryover). Subscription-native (hooks + subagent + skill, no API key). v0.5.8: `guard::fetch_session_lease`'s `overwatch lease` subprocess call is now bounded by an 8s timeout (wait_timeout, kill+reap on expiry) instead of a plain unbounded `Command::output()`, so a hung overwatch binary can no longer wedge the UserPromptSubmit hook; the spawn/timeout/kill mechanics are split into a testable `run_with_timeout` helper.

plugins.name: curate
plugins.description: Promote fugu-router playbooks into versioned golden eval datasets for evalkit: turn the append-only routing log into a curated, deduplicated holdout set. Mechanical acceptance criteria (`cargo test`, a backticked command) become runnable golden cases; the rest become drafts for a human to fill. The supply side of the offline eval loop. Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: deepwiki
plugins.description: Repository architecture wiki for Claude Code: a /deepwiki command that maps the repo with a bundled Rust scanner, has a subagent write & refresh hierarchical wiki pages (.deepwiki/*.md) with source links, and tracks freshness against git. Inspired by Devin Wiki. Subscription-native (binary + subagent + command, no API key).

plugins.name: difflog
plugins.description: Session diff-log for Claude Code: snapshot HEAD at SessionStart, write a structured git diff summary (commits, stat, files changed, bounded diff body) at SessionEnd. A /difflog skill can generate a human-readable narrative from the log. Subscription-native (no API key).

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Shipping-ritual nudge for Claude Code: deterministically detect unshipped state (uncommitted changes, unmerged condukt/* branches, leftover worktrees, unpushed commits, stale plugin binaries) and remind you to commit・merge・push・rebuild・rollout. A /ship skill and a fail-soft SessionEnd hook surface the checklist; only the plugin-rebuild (`--run-safe`, now `--stage-repo` so it refreshes the committed binary that stale-detection measures) and plugin-rollout (`ship rollout`, automates `/plugin update`) steps are auto-runnable — commit/merge/push stay human-gated. Subscription-native (no API key).

plugins.name: donegate
plugins.description: Completion-verification gate for Claude Code: on Stop, run your acceptance commands as subprocesses and block the stop until every required check is green, feeding failures back for an auto-fix loop. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key). v0.1.8: added #![deny(clippy::panic)] at crate root.

plugins.name: evalkit
plugins.description: Offline golden-regression eval harness for Claude Code plugins: read golden *.jsonl cases (file-content or CLI-output assertions) and exit non-zero when a prompt edit or CLI contract regresses. The offline sibling of condukt's online verifier — runnable as a CI gate with no API key. Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary).

plugins.name: benchkit
plugins.description: External-benchmark (SWE-bench Verified) runner for Claude Code plugins: a typed SWE-bench Instance model, a deterministic fixture-based JSONL loader, and a gated `download` subcommand that shells out to `curl` (no HTTP crate) to fetch the Princeton NLP dataset only on explicit invocation. Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary).

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Unified source→executor driver for Claude Code: a /flow skill that binds the task SOURCES (compass next-move + backlog queue) to the EXECUTOR (condukt, model-routed by fugu-router) in one HOTL loop — gate on compass freshness, pick the highest-priority task, hand it to condukt, verify, mark done, repeat. A SessionStart hook proposes /flow every session when open work exists (propose-then-confirm). Subscription-native (skill + hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: fugu-router
plugins.description: fugu-style per-model routing for Claude Code orchestration. Learns from past task outcomes (which model passed verification, at what cost) and picks the cheapest Claude tier that historically clears similar work. Feeds condukt's suggested_model deterministically; records outcomes back to a local episode store. No API key, no embedding service — lexical k-NN over a JSONL store. v0.1.12: `store::append_playbook` now writes body+newline in one `write_all` call (mirroring `append`'s existing single-syscall pattern) instead of `writeln!`'s two syscalls, closing the same O_APPEND interleaving hazard for playbook records; a JSON-serialization failure now propagates as an `io::Result` error instead of silently writing an empty line. New regression test `concurrent_append_playbook_never_interleaves_records`.

plugins.name: gauge
plugins.description: Local LLMOps telemetry for Claude Code: a Stop hook that reads each session's transcript and records token usage, cache hits, tool calls, latency, and estimated cost to a local store — then `gauge report` rolls it up by project, model, and day. Observability for your own agent runs, subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key, nothing leaves the machine).

plugins.name: harness-status
plugins.description: Unified HOTL status dashboard for Claude Code. A /status command runs a bundled Rust binary that aggregates budgetguard's spend ledger, gauge's session records (recent sessions + cost), and taskprog's progress file into one human-on-the-loop view. Subscription-native (binary + command, no API key). A lightweight SessionStart hook additionally warns (fail-soft, silent when healthy) if a registered hook's binary is missing from disk.

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Project knowledge retrieval + injection for Claude Code: a UserPromptSubmit hook that pulls the curated atomic notes relevant to your prompt and injects them under a strict char budget, so conventions and gotchas resurface without re-typing. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: precommit-audit
plugins.description: Config-driven pre-commit static audit for Claude Code: a Stop hook that runs generic checks plus your project rules (from a TOML file) over the pending diff — shelling out to git and optional linters — and blocks the stop, feeding findings back to the agent until they're clean. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: reviewgate
plugins.description: Code-review gate for Claude Code: on Stop, review the diff before the agent can declare done. In inject mode it blocks the stop and injects a review rubric so the running agent self-reviews (no API key); in subprocess mode it runs an independent reviewer and surfaces only its findings. Subscription-native, bundled Rust binary. v0.1.10: added #![deny(clippy::panic)] at crate root (existing test-module panic!() calls allowed locally).

plugins.name: runbook
plugins.description: Reusable procedure includes for Claude Code: a UserPromptSubmit hook that expands `!name` macros in your prompt into the matching repo-committed procedure (.runbook/<name>.md), so recurring workflows run the same way every time. Inspired by Devin Playbooks; distinct from knowledge injection. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: schemaguard
plugins.description: Schema-validation gate for LLM structured outputs at source→executor boundaries: validate a JSON value against a named declared schema (condukt decomposition, fugu episode/playbook, scout measure), emit a structured error a caller uses to re-ask the model once, and count rejects so silent drops become observable (Guardrails-AI-lite). Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary, no API key). v0.1.6: added #![deny(clippy::panic)] at crate root (main.rs + lib.rs).

plugins.name: session-insights
plugins.description: Per-session work metrics for Claude Code: PostToolUse + Stop hooks roll up tool calls, turns, files touched, a size class (XS–XL) and a work category per session, viewable with `session-insights report` and optionally logged as a dated note to an Obsidian vault. Inspired by Devin Session Insights. Subscription-native (two hooks + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: specguard
plugins.description: 仕様↔実装 整合監査ハーネスを Claude Code から subscription-native に実行する。各 shard を read-only な in-session subagent で監査し (nested claude --print なし)、決定的ハーネス (scope/render/parse/report) は specguard バイナリに委譲する。

plugins.name: stuckguard
plugins.description: Stuck-loop detector + escalation for Claude Code: a PostToolUse hook that spots repeated identical actions and edit thrash, then injects an escalating nudge to change approach or ask the user for help. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: taskprog
plugins.description: Multi-session progress file for Claude Code. Injects .claude/progress.md at SessionStart so the agent knows what is pending; at Stop it prompts the agent to keep the file current. Enables seamless HOTL handoff across sessions.

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Test-first gate for Claude Code: a Stop hook that blocks the turn when implementation code lands without an accompanying test, plus a /tdd skill and red/green/verify subcommands that make test-first (RED before GREEN) a verifiable artifact. Subscription-native (one hook + skill + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: tracekit
plugins.description: Span-tree tracer for condukt runs: record one run's interpreter→worker→verifier phases as a parent-linked span tree (phase, model, ms, cost, status), render it with `tracekit trace <RID>`, and export OpenTelemetry GenAI-semconv JSON. Answers which phase of a failed run was slow/expensive/broke. Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary, file-only, no network, no API key).

plugins.name: autoflow
plugins.description: Session-end auto-flow gate for Claude Code: on Stop, prompt /record once, then loop /condukt until pending tasks are cleared (auto up to 4×, ask the user from 5× onward). Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: hypothesis
plugins.description: PDO hypothesis lifecycle management for Claude Code: a /hypothesis skill plus create/validate/list/reject subcommands and a SessionStart hook to create, validate, and track discovery hypotheses aligned with compass goals. Subscription-native (skill + hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: overwatch
plugins.description: review-queue → backlog consolidation: `review-queue --to-backlog` now drains the WHOLE unified queue (ai-finding / systemic / rollback / escalation), not just AI findings — each not-yet-bridged entry is forwarded via `backlog add` so `/flow` can auto-repair it. The three non-finding streams are keyed on a composite `<kind>:<identifier>` in a separate `bridged_entries.jsonl` ledger so the finding-resolution source (`bridged_findings.jsonl`) is untouched; systemic/rollback/escalation ride one priority tier hotter (p0) and are tagged with their kind for filterability. Fail-soft throughout (missing store / absent backlog / failed add are warned and skipped; exit 0). Fixed CA-overwatch-004: AuditRound::new (the constructor the audit-round `record` CLI path uses) now clamps regression_tests_added to confirmed for every construction path, not just the separate close-path set_round_tests, so `audit-round record --confirmed N --regression-tests-added M` can no longer persist or report a closure_rate above the documented [0,1] range. continuous-audit SKILL.md's target-crate default doc now matches the real 6-crate DEFAULT_TARGETS (overwatch included) instead of understating 5. set_round_tests() clamps an over-large --tests count to the round's own confirmed count before storing, so audit-round close can never push closure_rate above the documented [0,1] range. Project-global cross-session execution ledger with dedup guard + PDO progress view. Manages claim registry with heartbeat-based liveness and skip-on-duplicate contract for distributed session coordination. SessionStart and Stop hooks surface current run state and progress aggregation (session/backlog/hypothesis/condukt run/compass gap in fail-soft view) via a short-lived (10s TTL) on-disk render cache, so the two hooks firing close together collapse into one full aggregate scan (~5 subprocess spawns) instead of two; a cold/expired/corrupt cache always falls through to a fresh build (fail-soft). Includes the /continuous-audit driver skill that runs an adversarial finder->verifier review round over the gate crates and auto-populates the unified review-queue (findings deduped by content fingerprint, not just id; repeated same-plugin rollbacks likewise collapse, each with an occurrences count). review-queue now also bridges condukt's durable escalation queue in fail-soft by path (`EntryKind::Escalation`, High severity) so blocked/GATED tasks awaiting a human answer show in the same unified pane. New `auto-approved` companion command surfaces the auto-approved (self-answered without a human) decision population from condukt's `gate-decisions.jsonl`, fail-soft by path, as a count plus a deterministic seeded sample, so sampling coverage of mass auto-approval stays auditable. `record-disposition`/`review-metrics` close the loop with review-effectiveness measurement (false-positive rate, human-agreement rate, median resolution latency); the integration tests now patch only the CLI-written ledgers' timestamp fields, keeping the CLI-serialized verdict/reviewer intact, so those assertions cover record-disposition's field serialization end-to-end. New `compact-findings` command performs non-lossy compaction/rotation of the append-only review_findings.jsonl hot store: resolved (bridged or dispositioned) findings are MOVED into a cold review_findings_archive.jsonl (atomic temp+rename, archive written before hot for crash-safety, idempotent) so review-queue's human-surface read stays bounded to OPEN items while review-metrics keeps joining archived findings via the combined hot-plus-archive history. Continuous-Audit finding triage: `ReviewFinding` gains an optional `rationale` field (the verifier's CONFIRMED rationale, `#[serde(default)]` for backward-compatible reads) wired through `record-finding --rationale`; a new `test_freshness` module reverse-looks-up a `#[ignore = "<finding-id>: ..."]` regression test by finding-id and re-runs it fail-soft (Passing/Failing/NotFound/ExecutionError); `review-queue --to-backlog` now thickens each backlog task's notes with elapsed days since confirmation, the rationale (if any), and the regression-test freshness verdict, all advisory-only. Subscription-native (skill + hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: daily
plugins.description: Daily-once task runner for Claude Code: a SessionStart hook that runs registered shell tasks ([[task]] in ~/.daily/config.toml) at most once per calendar day and injects a summary of what ran. Skips while a /flow or /backlog driver is working (backlog lock), records each run to a JSONL report (a failed task still counts as run, no retry until tomorrow). With no tasks registered it runs a default security audit (cargo deny check). Register/inspect with `daily add` / `daily list` / `daily report`. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Multi-lens project audit that generates actionable tasks (施策) for Claude Code: a /scout skill that gathers deterministic project state, fans out read-only sub-agents across five lenses (current issues, security, industry/peer-project practices via web search, missing measures, safety), then dedupes/scores findings into prioritized tasks, writes them to the backlog, and hands execution to /flow. Complements compass as a broad-reconnaissance SOURCE. Subscription-native (skill only, no binary, no API key).

plugins.name: daily-report
plugins.description: Generates a scannable daily work report (日報) by aggregating the day's git commits and the Obsidian session records that session-insights writes to the vault, then synthesizing them into a single narrative note written back to <vault>/daily/<date>.md. git supplies what changed in this repo; the Obsidian records supply cross-project summaries/learnings/remaining tasks and cost/token numbers. Subscription-native (skill only, no binary, no API key).

plugins.name: trajectoryeval
plugins.description: Trajectory-match verifier for agent tool-call paths: condukt's online verifier checks a task's OUTPUT (done_criteria); trajectoryeval checks the PATH the worker took. `check` matches an actual ordered tool-call list against an expected trajectory spec (strict / unordered / subsequence) and reports {pass, missing, unexpected, out_of_order} with a 0/1/2 gate exit; `extract` streams a transcript into the ordered tool_use names. The path-side sibling of done-criteria verification (agentevals-style). Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary, no API key).

plugins.name: replaykit
plugins.description: Trace→golden replay regression harness: turns a tracekit-recorded condukt run into an evalkit golden case so a real run becomes a committed regression fixture. `extract` distils a run's spans.jsonl into a portable trajectory summary (ordered phase/model/status steps + an `expect` block pinning phase set / error count / cost); `promote` writes the fixture under evals/replay/fixtures and appends a dedup'd golden whose `cmd` re-runs `replaykit verify`; `verify` recomputes those aggregates from the steps and gates 0/1/2. The trace-side sibling of curate's playbook→golden. Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary, file-only, no network, no API key).

plugins.name: propguard
plugins.description: Property gate for Claude Code: on Stop, derive 3–5 semantic properties (invariants) from a task's done_criteria and check the generated code against them before the agent can declare done. In inject mode it blocks and injects a property checklist for the running agent to self-verify (no API key); in subprocess mode it runs an independent checker and counts per-property PASS/FAIL, blocking when fewer than a threshold hold. Goes beyond 'concrete tests pass'. v0.1.16: merged two independently-developed Continuous-Audit fix lines that landed on the same v0.1.14 base — stopped correlation-store pollution (CA-propguard-03/04), and documented the checker subprocess timeout (checker_timeout_secs, default 300s, process-tree kill on timeout) with config-propagation tests. v0.1.13: fixed 3 subprocess-hang gaps (CA-propguard-004/005/006) — checker timeout now kills the whole shell-spawned process tree via a Unix process group, stdout reads are bounded so a lingering process can't hang them, and all git subprocess calls go through a timeout-bounded choke point with graceful fallback. Subscription-native, bundled Rust binary.
